svg.title: digline in an agentic flow
svg.desc: A looping diagram. An agent in production sends output through digline, a gate inside your repository. digline samples the output, measures it against a noise floor and compares it with the approved baseline stored in the repo. A drift within the measured floor is absorbed silently. A real drift is escalated to a human as a dossier; the human signs, and that signature is the only thing that updates the baseline. When the agent itself tries to write the baseline, it is refused: unknown tool: promote. Agents can measure. Humans approve.
